literal_edits.after: 1.2 **Base change from K.** Put $L=H^\Lambda_\alpha(\mathbb Z)$ and let $C_{\mathbb Q}$ be the rational KLR presentation. Its generator map $C_{\mathbb Q}\twoheadrightarrow\mathbb Q\otimes_{\mathbb Z}L$ is surjective by [F3]. Extending to $K$ gives the composition $C_K\twoheadrightarrow K\otimes_{\mathbb Z}L\twoheadrightarrow H^\Lambda_\alpha(K)$, with the second arrow induced by the inclusion of $L$. Both arrows are surjective because their named generators generate the targets, and their composition is the generator-matching BK isomorphism of [F2]; therefore both arrows are isomorphisms. Faithful scalar extension from $\mathbb Q$ to $K$ also proves the rational generator map is an isomorphism, without requiring a Hecke root of unity in $\mathbb Q$. Hence the lattice has rank $\dim_KH^\Lambda_\alpha(K)$ and the first base-change map is an isomorphism of graded algebras. [F2, F3]
